name: How does Kelby Contreras determine the value of my rental property in the current market?

mainEntity.name: How does Kelby Contreras determine the value of my rental property in the current market?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kelby Contreras determines the value of your rental property by conducting a comprehensive market analysis. This involves evaluating recent comparable sales in your specific area, such as Aventura or Coral Gables, assessing property condition, considering current rental income, and analyzing market demand. This first-party insight allows us to provide an accurate valuation and develop a competitive pricing strategy that reflects the unique attributes of your property and the prevailing market conditions, ensuring it is positioned effectively for sale.
acceptedAnswer.description: We determine value through a market analysis, evaluating comparable sales, property condition, rental income, and market demand in your area.
